description: Toluene fumes off a rag. The same can that thins paint and cuts a batch, breathed straight: cheap, everywhere, and it takes a piece of you every time.

effects.comeon_message: You soak the rag, cup it over your mouth, and pull. The sweetness gets there before the burn does.

events.text: [trip]The room goes bright and flat, like somebody turned the contrast all the way up.[/trip]
[trip]There's a bee in the back of your skull and it has been there for years.[/trip]
[trip]You lose the thread of your own sentence. You weren't saying it out loud anyway.[/trip]
[trip]It lets go all at once and leaves the headache behind as a receipt.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Everything goes woolly and pleasantly stupid.

overdose.message: You take one pull too many in a room with nothing else in the air. Your heart trips over itself in the dark and doesn't get back up.

phases.comedown_message: The headache arrives on schedule and settles behind your eyes.
phases.end_message: You come back with a mouth full of solvent and a little less than you started with.

effects.take_line: You wet a rag from {name} and breathe it in.

withdrawal.message: Your hands are unsteady and the workshop shelf keeps catching your eye.

stages.easing: The pressure lets off. Some of what it was pressing on doesn't come back.
stages.onset: The taste comes back first, at the back of the teeth, out of nowhere.
stages.peak: Your head is packed tight and you have read the same line four times without any of it arriving.
stages.rising: Your hands are unsteady enough to be a problem with small screws.
stages.tail: Steady hands. A word you wanted this morning has still not turned up.

name: toluene
